text: Hello there! Let's find out what the weather is like on this Monday, October 12. It's Monday, the start of a brand new week. Today in Shanghai, it will be cloudy with hardly any sun. It will reach 26 degrees, and drop down to 17 degrees. It should feel gently warm all day. Rain is very unlikely today. The sun goes down at 5:26 this evening, about 2 minutes earlier than yesterday. Can you feel the days getting shorter? A comfortable day for a walk, not too hot and not too cold. Looking ahead to tomorrow, it will be under a blanket of cloud, reaching 26 degrees. This week our theme is jumpers and socks. Notice which ones are cosiest. And that's the weather. Have a brilliant day!
